tekst.pyt: What is the main difference between general "Red Pill" self-help communities and the "Incel" subculture described in the text?
tekst.pl: Red Pill = praca nad sobą (ciężary, kariera); incele odpuszczają i obwiniają.
tekst.en: Red Pill communities focus on self-improvement, like weightlifting and career ambition. Incels give up on that and blame women and society instead.

tekst.pyt: How does the "Black Pill" ideology lead users into psychological defeatism and hopelessness?
tekst.pl: Wygląd i genetyka decydują o wartości, więc starania nie mają sensu — pułapka.
tekst.en: It argues that looks and genetics determine your worth, so self-improvement is pointless. Once you believe that, you feel fundamentally trapped.

tekst.pyt: What pseudo-scientific hierarchy and internal jargon do online incel forums use to categorize society?
tekst.pl: Dwa człony: archetypy Chad/Stacy ORAZ własny żargon odczłowieczający obcych.
tekst.en: They categorize people into rigid archetypes — "Chads" for hyper-attractive men and "Stacys" for unattainable women. They also build their own jargon that dehumanizes outsiders.

tekst.pyt: What real-world violent events mentioned in the article led law enforcement agencies to classify extreme incel ideology as a form of terrorism?
tekst.pl: Isla Vista 2014 i Toronto 2018 (jedenaście ofiar); domknij klauzulą o klasyfikacji.
tekst.en: A shooting in Isla Vista in 2014 and a van attack in Toronto in 2018 that killed eleven people. Since then, law enforcement agencies classify this as non-traditional domestic terrorism.

tekst.pyt: In what ways do social media recommendation algorithms accidentally funnel users searching for basic self-help into extremist content?
tekst.pl: Silnik nagradza oglądalność, więc wygrywają emocje; potem sprzężenie zwrotne.
tekst.en: Recommendation engines prioritize whatever keeps people watching, so emotionally provocative videos win. That creates a feedback loop where someone looking for fitness advice gets funneled into increasingly radical content.

tekst.pyt: Why is it difficult for governments to regulate toxic online forums while simultaneously protecting freedom of speech?
tekst.pl: Granica między brzydką opinią a groźbą; bany spychają fora do podziemia.
tekst.en: The line between an ugly opinion and a real threat is hard to draw. And banning forums often just drives them underground, where nobody is monitoring them.

tekst.pyt: Which of those two groups do you think is more dangerous, and why?
tekst.pl: Incele — bardziej nihilistyczni, odbierają nadzieję; zaznacz, że to Twoje odczytanie.
tekst.en: I'd say the incel side, because it's more nihilistic and takes away all hope of changing your situation. But that's just my reading of the article.

tekst.pyt: Do you think the article is fair to the men it describes?
tekst.pl: W większości tak, ale opiera się na skrajnych przypadkach — i zdystansuj się.
tekst.en: Mostly, yes, but it leans on extreme cases. To be clear, I'm not defending them — I just think most of them never become violent.

tekst.pyt: Can you explain what an echo chamber is in your own words?
tekst.pl: Nie miejsce, tylko środowisko społeczne; wzmacnia to, w co już wierzysz.
tekst.en: It's a social environment, not a place — you only hear opinions that match your own. Over time, it just reinforces whatever you already believe.

tekst.pyt: Why do you think young men end up in these communities in the first place?
tekst.pl: Samotność i brak wsparcia; algorytm podaje im gotową wspólnotę.
tekst.en: Loneliness, mostly, and very little support when they struggle. The algorithm then hands them a community that explains their pain for them.

tekst.pyt: Why would anyone believe that self-improvement is pointless?
tekst.pl: Bo to zdejmuje presję — jeśli nic nie zależy od ciebie, porażka nie jest twoją winą.
tekst.en: Because it takes the pressure off. If everything is pointless, then failing isn't your fault anymore.

tekst.pyt: The text says these men feel trapped. Do you think that's true?
tekst.pl: Pułapką jest przekonanie, nie geny — u nich to hierarchia „o wszystkim decyduje".
tekst.en: They're trapped by what they believe, not by their genes. In their view, a fixed hierarchy determines everything — and that's what keeps them stuck.

tekst.pyt: Why does the article call some of these men martyrs?
tekst.pl: Nie artykuł, tylko fora; to one czczą zamachowców; gorycz robi się groźna.
tekst.en: It doesn't — the forums do. According to the article, those spaces celebrate past attackers as martyrs, and that's how bitterness turns into something dangerous.

tekst.pyt: Why is the word "martyr" so dangerous in this context?
tekst.pl: Zabójca staje się wzorem do naśladowania; wtedy przestaje to być samo gadanie.
tekst.en: Calling a killer a martyr turns a crime into an example to follow. That's when an online echo chamber stops being just talk.

tekst.pyt: Do you agree or disagree: "Tech platforms and social media companies should be held legally responsible when violent attacks are planned on their platforms"? Why or why not?
tekst.pl: Częściowo tak: jeśli ostrzeżeni i nic nie zrobili — tak; za wszystko — nie.
tekst.en: I'd say partly. If a company is warned about a threat and does nothing, it should be held responsible, but you can't hold it liable for everything users post.

tekst.pyt: How can societies better address issues of male isolation and mental health before young people fall into toxic online communities?
tekst.pl: Dotrzeć wcześniej: szkoła, sport, tania terapia; rozmowa ma być normalna.
tekst.en: Reach them before the forums do, through schools, sports, and affordable therapy. It also has to become normal for men to talk about this.

tekst.pyt: What steps should be taken in schools or universities to educate students about digital media literacy and avoiding online radicalization?
tekst.pl: Pokaż, jak działa algorytm, na prawdziwych przykładach — wtedy traci moc.
tekst.en: Teach students how recommendation algorithms actually work, using real examples. If you can see why a video was pushed to you, it loses a lot of its power.

tekst.pyt: Is online content moderation effective, or does banning radical forums simply push extremist groups into secret, unmonitored parts of the internet?
tekst.pl: Obie rzeczy naraz: tnie zasięg, ale najtwardszych spycha do podziemia.
tekst.en: Both, honestly. Moderation cuts the reach of these groups, but it also drives the hardcore ones underground, where nobody can monitor them.

tekst.pyt: How can friends and family members recognize the warning signs that someone they know is becoming radicalized online?
tekst.pl: Wycofanie, całe dnie online, nowy żargon; gniew wymierzony w całą grupę ludzi.
tekst.en: They pull away from friends, spend all their time online, and start using jargon nobody else uses. The clearest sign is anger aimed at a whole group of people.

tekst.pyt: Where exactly would you draw the line on free speech?
tekst.pl: Groźby i nękanie konkretnych osób — tak; brzydka opinia — nie.
tekst.en: I'd draw it at direct threats and harassment of real people. An ugly opinion is legal, but telling people to go after someone isn't.

tekst.pyt: Isn't teaching media literacy just too slow to help?
tekst.pl: Przyznaj, że wolne, ale jako jedyne zostaje na dłużej.
tekst.en: It is slow, but it's the only part that lasts. Moderation treats the symptom; education treats the cause.

tekst.pyt: If someone close to you started talking like that, what would you actually do?
tekst.pl: Zostać w kontakcie i pytać zamiast się kłócić.
tekst.en: I'd stay in touch and keep asking questions instead of arguing. What these guys need most is someone who doesn't write them off.

tekst.pyt: Do you think this problem is as big in Poland as in the US?
tekst.pl: Mniejsze, ale te same filmy docierają — algorytm nie zna granic.
tekst.en: It's smaller here, but the same videos reach us. The algorithm doesn't really care which country you're in.

tekst.pyt: Is there anything in the article you'd push back on?
tekst.pl: Rozwój osobisty jako „zdrowa strona" — te same siłownie karmią obie strony.
tekst.en: It treats self-improvement as the healthy alternative, but the same gyms and podcasts feed the other side too. So I wouldn't draw that line so cleanly.

tekst.pyt: What would you say to a young man who already believes all of that?
tekst.pl: Najpierw samotność na poważnie, nie spór o hierarchię; o goryczy łatwiej rozmawiać.
tekst.en: I'd start by taking his loneliness seriously instead of arguing about the hierarchy. Bitterness is easier to talk about than ideology.

tekst.pyt: If you had to sum up the whole article in one sentence, what would you say?
tekst.pl: Cytat z ramki: wyizolowana samotność zamienia się w zbiorową nienawiść.
tekst.en: Online echo chambers can turn isolated personal loneliness into collective hatred, and the algorithms make that path shorter.
